name: Ashen Reverie
source:
You’ve ignored the hallucinations for years. But after visiting a shrine in search of answers, a stranger claims she sees them too. Ashen Reverie is a visual novel about the consequences of chasing a myth too far.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3515710/Ashen_Reverie/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
多年来你一直忽视这些幻觉。但在参观神社寻找答案后，一名陌生人声称她也看到了他们。《Ashen Reverie》是一部视觉小说，讲述了过度追逐神话所带来的后果。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3515710/Ashen_Reverie/]Steam[/url]]
